issues.detail: The Greek 'ινα μη α αν θελητε ταυτα ποιητε' means 'so that you may not do these things if you will' (expressing an inability or prohibition based on the conflict), but the Vietnamese 'để anh em không làm điều mình muốn' translates to 'so that you don't do what you want', which changes the logical structure of the conditional statement.
